visual_evidence: Image is printed page 766 of the June 25, 1936 Federal Register. Its left column has publication information and a TABLE OF CONTENTS entry pointing to 'Authorizing Charles O. Gregory to act as Secretary of Labor' on page 765; the body on page 766 continues the naval-radio-station land description. The complete Gregory order is on the previous printed page 765, not in this image.

Image is printed page 767. The signed order in the lower left is titled 'Amendment of Subdivision IX, Schedule A, Civil Service Rules' and its closing printed identifier is [No. 7400], signed Franklin D. Roosevelt, dated June 23, 1936. It is not EO 7398.

The upper left of printed page 765 says 'By virtue of the authority vested in me under the provisions of section 179 of the Revised Statutes of the United States (5 U. S. C., sec. 6)'. The printed section is 179, not 170.
